Interface AIiActionExecutionContext<I extends eu.algites.lib.action.interaction.AIiActionInteractionProviderToCaller<?,?,?,?,?>>

Type Parameters:
I - provider-facing interaction view specialized by the application
All Superinterfaces:
eu.algites.lib.action.execution.common.AIiExecutionContext
public interface AIiActionExecutionContext<I extends eu.algites.lib.action.interaction.AIiActionInteractionProviderToCaller<?,?,?,?,?>> extends eu.algites.lib.action.execution.common.AIiExecutionContext
Explicit per-attempt worker context with typed provider interaction. The context is execution-scoped, NOT an implicit mutable transaction controller.
